text:
Andrew: Heads up — ARB this Fri 10:00–10:45 PT. Need a facilitator and a curated agenda. RFC slate I'm proposing: model-routing (Sam), kv-cache perf (Maria), infra standards tweaks (Zach). Can owners confirm and say if they need >10m.

Sam: I can present model-routing. 15 min ish incl Qs. happy to swap facil if someone else wants it.

Maria: I can do kv-cache perf. I only need ~8–10m. Would like a slot for canary rollout concerns — add 5 mins?

Zach: infra-standards looks fine. prefer 20m to cover the policy + migration plan. small conflict at 10am tho — would 11am work for folks?

Andrew: 11am collides with Ops weekly. Two options: keep 10:00 and shorten infra to 12m + follow-up RFC triage, or run a quick separate triage at 09:30. Thoughts?

Sam: I vote keep 10 and tighten slots. Quick triage at 09:30 sounds disruptive to the flow.

Maria: I can facilitate if nobody else wants to. I'll also curate the agenda and add pre-reads. @Sam please drop your PR/slide link.

Zach: If Maria facilitates I can compress infra to 12 min and leave deep-dive for post-meet. +1 to Maria facilitating.

Andrew: Great — Maria volunteered to facilitate. Maria: can you do the agenda doc & send calendar invite with notes? Suggest agenda template:

```
1) Quick welcome + facilitator notes (2m)
2) RFC quick wins & blockers (3x) — 10m
   - model-routing (Sam) — 10m
   - kv-cache perf (Maria) — 8m
   - infra standards (Zach) — 12m
3) AOB / rollout check / follow-ups — 5m
4) Action items & owners — 3m
```

Sam: I'll add slides/PR: https://git.company/repo/model-routing/pull/87 (pre-read pinned)

Maria: Added my short notes and a perf snippet to the doc. Will pin the pre-read in the calendar invite.

Andrew: TL;DR: Maria facilitates, Sam/Zach confirm compressed slots, pre-reads in doc. Maria — if you want, set a hard 45m block and we can spin up a follow-up triage channel for overflow.

Maria: Will do. I'll also add a small facilitation checklist for running timeboxed RFC reviews: what to capture, pinging authors, and when to gate-to-post-mortem.

eng-bot: Event created: "ARB — Fri 10:00 PT" (calendar invite sent to eng-platform; pre-reads attached).

Sam: :thumbsup: Thanks all.

Zach: Thanks — will prep a 2-slide migration plan and a one-line risk summary.

Andrew: Perfect. If anyone else wants to add an item, add it to the agenda doc by EOD Thu or we'll queue for the next ARB.

Maria: will ping presenters with time checks and do a quick facilitation runbook in the doc.

Sam: ack.

Andrew: thanks team — see you Friday.
